brand_voice.tone: Independent, authoritative, analytical, direct, helpful, webmaster-focused.
brand_voice.perspective: First-person plural ('we at AmzLoss') or objective expert analysis.
banned_phrases: It is important to remember that
Whether you are a beginner or an expert
In conclusion, it is clear that

writing_style.formatting: Use bold text for key metrics, bullet lists for multi-item breakdowns, and callout boxes for warnings/tips.
writing_style.reading_level: Grade 8-10 (clear, crisp, accessible to bloggers and developers).

elements.name: Header & Hero
elements.description: Title, category kicker, reading time, last updated date.

elements.name: TL;DR Summary
elements.description: Key takeaways box at top highlighting the core formula or finding.

elements.name: Core Analysis
elements.description: Detailed explanation of the topic, rate math, or audit step.

elements.name: Practical Step-by-Step
elements.description: Numbered instructions showing how to calculate, audit, or optimize.

elements.name: Real Example / Case Study
elements.description: Concrete dollar figures showing price drop vs commission earned.

elements.name: FAQ Section
elements.description: 3-5 structured questions and short answers for FAQ schema.

elements.name: Related Tools CTA
elements.description: Contextual links to AmzLoss calculators or audit tools.

introduction_patterns.good: Amazon reduced baseline commissions across several popular categories in 2026. If your earnings dropped despite steady traffic, here is the exact math to check if you were underpaid—and how to calculate your true break-even price.
introduction_patterns.bad: In today's world of e-commerce, affiliate marketing is a popular way to make money online. Many creators use Amazon Associates to monetize their traffic...

faq_rules.format: Clear, concise answers (2-3 sentences max per answer). Must match FAQPage JSON-LD schema.

good_example.title: Calculating 2026 Amazon Commission in Three Steps
strengths: Clear formula: Eligible Amount x Category Rate

poor_example.title: How to Make Money with Amazon

rules: Amazon 2026 rate table percentages must match official rates (e.g., Luxury Beauty 10%, Apparel 4%, Electronics 4%, Home 3%, Video Games 1%).
Never claim Amazon steals money or guarantees refunds; frame audits as identifying discrepancies or rate misclassifications.

Ensure all tool links lead to valid site pages (calculator.html, audit.html, rates.html, breakeven.html, networks.html, link-builder.html, backlink-checker.html, url-submitter.html, directory.html, earnings-analyzer.html).
